description: This file defines internal structures and function pointers for handling transport mechanisms, including operations like setting options, fetching refs, pushing refs, connecting, and disconnecting. It is used within a larger version control system to abstract transport layer interactions.

methods.name: set_option
methods.description: Sets an option for the transport connection, returning a status code indicating success, unrecognized option, or invalid value.

methods.name: get_refs_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of references from the remote side, with support for sharing connections and determining remote hashes.

methods.name: get_bundle_uri
methods.description: Gets the bundle URI under protocol v2 if advertised by the remote, returning 0 on success.

methods.name: fetch_refs
methods.description: Fetches objects for specified refs, updating old_sha1 fields if necessary.

methods.name: push_refs
methods.description: Pushes objects and refs to the remote, updating refs when necessary and modifying new_sha1 in refs.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the remote, providing connection details and file descriptors.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the transport connection.

ctags.name: connect
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(struct transport * connection,const char * name,const char * executable,int fd[2])

ctags.name: fetch_refs
ctags.pattern: /^	int (*fetch_refs)(struct transport *transport, int refs_nr, struct ref **refs);$/
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(struct transport * transport,int refs_nr,struct ref ** refs)

ctags.name: get_refs_list
ctags.typeref: struct:ref * (*)(struct transport * transport,int for_push,struct transport_ls_refs_options * transport_options)

ctags.name: push_refs
ctags.pattern: /^	int (*push_refs)(struct transport *transport, struct ref *refs, int flags);$/
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(struct transport * transport,struct ref * refs,int flags)

ctags.name: set_option
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(struct transport * connection,const char * name,const char * value)
